text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - epic
      - develop

jobs:
  notify_code_owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Notify code owner
        if: github.event.pull_request.user.login != github.event.repository.owner.login
        run: |
          CODE_OWNER=$(git ls-files --stage | grep "100644" | awk '{print $NF}' | xargs git blame -e | sort -u | head -n 1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
          echo "Code review requested by @${CODE_OWNER}"
          curl -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ github.event.number }}/comments \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"body\": \"@${CODE_OWNER} please review this PR\"}"
```
